summary.tldr: Lets people bypass certain copyright locks on products when needed to diagnose, maintain or repair them.
what_it_does: Adds a Copyright Act exception that lets a person circumvent a technological protection measure when the only purpose is to maintain or repair a product, including diagnosing it, if the protected work is part of the product.
Extends that exception to a person who does the diagnosis, maintenance or repair for someone else.
Keeps the exception from applying if the person does an act that infringes copyright.
Updates the Copyright Act definitions of "circumvent" and "technological protection measure".
summary.background: The Copyright Act now limits the circumvention of technological protection measures, which are controls on access to a work, performer’s performance or sound recording. This bill adds a repair exception to that rule.
